title: Chapter 458 - 458 Representative; End Early
content:
Chapter 458 - 458 Representative; End Early

Chapter 458 - 458 Representative; End Early

458 Representative; End Early

Zheng Cong became more and more excited as he spoke. His voice also became more and more high-pitched.

At this moment, he felt as if his entire body was blooming with light. He thought that he must appear so dazzling and eye-catching right now.

Then, Zheng Cong’s gaze landed on Hu Tian, who was below the stage.

It was as if he was saying, ‘Did you hear that? My annual salary is more than 1.5 million yuan, and I have a high stock incentive!’

Then, he did not forget to look at Lin Fan as if he was saying, ‘Although you and Hu Tian work together, you can’t compare to me!’

Zheng Cong said a few more words before slowly walking down the stage.

According to the arranged order, it should be a tall and thin man who went on stage next to give his speech.

However, Wang Haoran, who was sitting at the back, took the lead and walked up.

The tall and thin man was stunned.

However, he did not say anything.

After all, this was just a seminar.

It did not matter who went first.

In Wang Haoran’s heart, however, this was not the case.

That was because…

Zheng Cong had just mentioned his annual salary and benefits. Perhaps he had already left a good impression on Hu Tian.

What if Hu Tian had a good impression of him?

What should he do then?

Wang Haoran felt that it was necessary to stop or reduce Hu Tian’s favorable impression of Zheng Cong at the first possible moment.

Therefore, he quickly walked onto the stage.

“Good morning, school leaders and entrepreneurs!

“I’m Wang Haoran, the vice president of Feitu Network. Feitu Network has 20 branches in the country and a total of more than 4,000 employees. Our main focus is on developing games, chat software, social software, web page maintenance, and so on.

“We, Feitu Network, have many routes of development.

“If you like software development, you can directly join the technical department.

“If you like the news, you can join the entertainment department.

“If you like to communicate with others, you can join the sales and public relations departments.”

…

“All in all, Feitu Network recruits all kinds of talents.

“In addition, the salary of P1 employees is 300,000 yuan per year, plus a bonus of more than 120,000 yuan.

“P2 employees receive a salary of 500,000 a year, plus a bonus of 150,000.

“P3 employees receive a salary of 800,000 yuan per year, plus a 300,000 yuan bonus and equity incentive.

“P4 employees will have an annual salary of one million yuan, plus a bonus of more than 500,000 yuan, as well as a large amount of equity incentive.

“P5 employees receive a salary of two million, plus a bonus of one million and a large amount of equity incentive.

“Many people find it extremely difficult to climb the corporate ladder in most companies… It can even be said that the path is full of obstacles.

“However, Feitu is different. We’re still in the rising stage. As long as you have the ability, you can be promoted very quickly.

“Let me use myself as an example. Just like Director Zheng from Huidong Accounting Firm, I graduated from Jiangbei University. He spent five years to become a P4-level employee of Huidong, while I only spent four years going from P1 to P5 at Feitu Network! Look, I’ve already become the vice president of Feitu Network!”

When Wang Haoran said this, his pitch became extremely high, and his gaze landed on Hu Tian.

It was as if he was saying, ‘Hu Tian, did you hear me? I’m at the P5 level! I have an annual salary of two million, plus a bonus of more than one million, as well as a large amount of equity incentive!’

In Wang Haoran’s opinion, he was definitely like an angel with a pair of pure white wings in Hu Tian’s eyes at this moment. He was extremely charming!

The more he thought about it, the wider the smile on Wang Haoran’s face became.

Then, he did not forget to cast a smug look at Zheng Cong.

Wang Haoran said a few more words and slowly walked off the stage.

After the company representatives went on stage to speak, Feng Weijian, the vice-chancellor of Jiangbei University, finally picked up the microphone and said, “Thank you very much to the representatives of the various companies for coming to our school to recruit talents.

“This is a sign of trust in our school and their high opinion of our school’s nurturing of students…

“I already know the number of recruits each company is hiring, but there’s still a huge gap compared to the number of our graduates this year. I wonder if there’ll be any increase in the number of positions?

“I can guarantee that if you choose more students from Jianghai University, it’ll bring more benefits to your companies in the future!”

The representatives looked at each other, but no one spoke.

After all, the number of people and positions hired were things that the company had already decided on according to their needs. They could not increase them at will.

Wang Haoran, who was sitting below the stage, muttered, “Vice-Chancellor Feng is right! Hiring more students from Jianghai University will bring more benefits to the companies. I agree with this very much!

“As I graduated from Jiangbei University myself, I understand the University of Jianghai and its spirit! Feitu Network can add another 20 positions!”

“Good!” Feng Weijian said happily. “On behalf of the graduating students of Jiangbei University, I’d like to thank Director Wang!”

Wang Haoran’s face was also full of smiles.

Then, he cast a smug look at Hu Tian.

This scene was witnessed by Zheng Cong.

He gritted his teeth and said, “I also agree with Vice-Chancellor Feng’s point of view. Therefore, Huidong Accounting Firm will also add another 20 positions!”

“Alright, alright!” Feng Weijian said. “Thank you, Director Zheng!”

When Zheng Cong heard this, he also smiled at Hu Tian.
